name: IONOS VPS
line: Rent a virtual server with root or administrator access.

work.math: 3 months at $2 + 9 months at $6 = $60, or $5 a month on average over 12 months if the $6 price starts after month 3. Tax, domain and CI are not included.
The same $60 over 12 months, if conditions apply, = $5 a month average. The plan has 1 vCore and 2 GB RAM, but request capacity is not verified.
The base averages $5 a month in year 1 if $6 bills after month 3. Backup is $0.065 per stored GB a month, but the size is unknown.
